message.content: {"note_claim": "Uber announced a cut of about 3,300 corporate jobs globally in a restructuring to flatten management layers, not drivers and not Brazil-specific or due to local economic crisis.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "A Uber Technologies vai demitir cerca de 3.300 funcionários, ou 10% do seu quadro de pessoal", "reason": "The page confirms ~3,300 employee layoffs (10% of staff, globally ~34,000 employees) tied to flattening management layers and robotaxi competition, not drivers or Brazil's economy; the note's 'set/2029' date appears to be an error but the core claim is substantiated."}

parsed.note_claim: Uber announced a cut of about 3,300 corporate jobs globally in a restructuring to flatten management layers, not drivers and not Brazil-specific or due to local economic crisis.
